Weightless Shoulder Throw.name: Weightless Shoulder Throw
Weightless Shoulder Throw.description: The user touches an opponent within reach with all five fingertip pads, floats them and pulls their arm into a shoulder throw. A low release deals light bludgeoning damage; held back, the user guides them onto their back without a drop. The user needs a secure grip, and a target who breaks contact before all pads land avoids activation. Strain: light.
